svg.title: Lab as built, 2026-11-01
svg.desc: Reference card of my home lab: edge chain, flat LAN, three Proxmox nodes with their VMs, tailnet and cloud hosts, Caddy names behind the Authelia gate, Tailscale paths and the monitoring scrape flow. Addresses are shown as network segments and hosts by role.
svg.text: Documented state from my lab inventory, proxy config and monitoring config as code. Addresses are shown as segments and hosts by role. Not a live check.

text.tspan: · flat, VLAN 1 untagged · no VLANs · no firewall, NAT or QoS rules

svg.text: LAN · web via proxy, Git over SSH
node_exporter on the node and every VM
Nebula Sync: hourly, DNS primary to secondary
off-LAN admin, split DNS for the internal names, tailnet scrapes
Tailscale Serve for the admin UIs
Public IPs are not recorded in the inventory and are not drawn.
Analytics dashboard: loopback on the VPS, admin over the tailnet.
Kuma, Umami and ntfy keep their own logins: the VPS cannot reach Authelia.
Public-safe version: real addresses, hostnames and VM ids are kept in my private records.
Caddy internal proxy · one wildcard name per service
wildcard cert by Cloudflare DNS-01 · names resolve only inside:
Pi-hole answers them on the LAN, Tailscale split DNS off-LAN, no public record
forward_auth goes to Authelia on the proxy host's loopback.
OIDC clients in Authelia: Forgejo, Grafana, Proxmox VE, PBS, Arcane.
Git forge stays off the gate: Git over HTTPS and API tokens would break.
Outside the proxy: the gateway UI, and Kuma, Umami and ntfy on the VPS.
Each app keeps a local break-glass admin.
Tailscale routers 1 and 2 (one per main node): subnet routers into the LAN
off-LAN client → tailnet → subnet router → LAN host or internal proxy
internal names off-LAN: Tailscale split DNS; on the LAN: Pi-hole
Monitoring scrapes the VPS and the cloud VM over the tailnet
VPS admin UIs (Kuma, ntfy admin) through Tailscale Serve, tailnet only
Gateway UI direct to the UDM Pro, from the LAN or over Tailscale
GCP relay: ephemeral public IP, reached over Tailscale
Not on the tailnet: the Linux workstation.
config as code: 15 jobs, 58 static targets · interval 15s, HTTPS probes 60s
automation · Git forge · CI runner · internal proxy
DNS x2 · Tailscale routers x2 · remote desktop · VPS, cloud VM
DNS over UDP: the VIP and both DNS VMs
TCP: 10 management ports · 3 Proxmox UIs · 3 remote desktop
HTTPS through the proxy: 2 open, 11 expect the gate
public HTTPS: portfolio, blog, status page, analytics script
PBS exporter for the backup server
every alert → n8n webhook → ntfy push (VPS)
critical inhibits warning on the same instance
journald (Git forge also containers) → Loki on monitoring
Loki → Grafana datasource and log alerting · no public listener
